mentions.name: Firmament
mentions.description: A clustering system for Podman volumes that uses Serf and the built-in Podman import/export API to move volumes to where they need to be in the cluster. Still an early-stage idea, planned to start after Materia reaches 1.0.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also been kicking around a clustering system for Podman volumes called Firmament  that uses Serf and the built-in Podman import/export API to move volumes to where they need to be in the cluster.
